keybindprofilesplus.settings.replace_key: Replace the vanilla Key Binds screen

ON: Options -> Controls -> Key Binds opens this mod's screen, where keys can be changed and every key shows its source mod and its conflicts. OFF: the vanilla screen is kept, with this mod's buttons and conflict markers added to it.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.keybindpr: Save, compare, share and instantly switch whole sets of key bindings, optionally together with chosen game settings. Its Key Binds screen shows which mod every key comes from, marks real conflicts, supports Ctrl/Shift/Alt combinations and also edits the hotkeys of Meteor Client, MaLiLib mods and Inventory Profiles Next. Based on KeyBindProfiles by sawiq_.
keybindprofilesplus.server.rule.situatio: While in this dimension (then back to the profile before)
While gliding with an elytra (then back to the profile before)
While this item is worn (then back to the profile before)
While this item is in the main hand (then back to the profile before)
keybindprofilesplus.situation.help: For a while: this profile is put on while it applies, and the one before comes back afterwards. Rules: in:the_nether, in:the_end, in:overworld, flying (gliding with an elytra), wearing:elytra, holding:bow (any item id). Holding beats gliding beats wearing beats a dimension; all of them beat server rules while they apply. Picking a profile yourself meanwhile wins until the situation is over.
keybindprofilesplus.status.situation_inv: Write it like in:the_nether, holding:bow, wearing:elytra or flying
keybindprofilesplus.keyboard.tooltip: A picture of the keyboard and mouse: grey keys are free, blue ones are used, red or yellow ones have a conflict. Point at a key to see what is on it; click it to list only that key.
keybindprofilesplus.keyboard.click: Click: show only this key in the list
keybindprofilesplus.settings.keyboard_vi: Key Binds opens on the keyboard
The Key Binds screen starts with the keyboard picture instead of the list. The button at the top switches either way.
keybindprofilesplus.hold.flip: Turn over: normal key / long-press key (Accurate Hotkeys)
